notes:
JARVIS v0.5.10

本次更新修正日曆活動被改到錯誤時間的問題。

修正
- Mac 的時區與 Google 日曆的時區不同時（例如人在英國、日曆用香港時間），要求 JARVIS 更改活動時間，活動會被移到錯誤的時間。JARVIS 現在會先把活動時間換算成 Mac 的時區，才讀取、回答或更改。
- JARVIS 回答行程時所說的時間，與 App 日曆頁一致，都以 Mac 的時區顯示。
notes_en:
JARVIS v0.5.10

This update fixes calendar events being moved to the wrong time.

Fixed
- When your Mac and your Google Calendar were set to different time zones (for example, you are in the UK and your calendar is on Hong Kong time), asking JARVIS to change an event's time could move it to the wrong time. JARVIS now converts event times to your Mac's time zone before it reads, answers about or changes them.
- When JARVIS tells you about your schedule, it gives the same times as the app's Calendar page, in your Mac's time zone.
